about: Justin Allamano is an attorney providing legal services covering Real Estate: Business, Business / Corporate, Securities & Corporate Finance, Intellectual Property and Land Use / Zoning.

Justin Allamano, who practices law in Corte Madera, California, was selected to Rising Stars for 2015 - 2018. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Rising Stars selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of California Davis School of Law. He graduated in 2003. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
